CustomField.description: This will calculate the number of months between the between policy expiration date and ere expiration date.
CustomField.formula: IF(NOT(ISBLANK(ERE_Expiration_Date__c)) && NOT(ISBLANK(Policy_Expiration_Date__c)) ,(((YEAR(ERE_Expiration_Date__c) - YEAR(Policy_Expiration_Date__c) - 1) *12) + (12 - MONTH(Policy_Expiration_Date__c) +1) + MONTH(ERE_Expiration_Date__c)) , null ) - 1
CustomField.label: ERE Months
